name: Omacross
author: Omacross
description: Mario's Picross in the Omarchy bar. Nonogram puzzles on a themed grid, played with the mouse or with VIM motions.

barWidget.description: A picross (nonogram) game: reveal a hidden picture from its row and column clues before the clock runs out.

schema.label: Starting difficulty
schema.description: Grid size and clock: easy is 5×5 in 10:00, normal 10×10 in 30:00, hard 15×15 in 45:00.

schema.label: Extra pictures folder
schema.description: A folder of .picross files to play alongside the bundled ones. Defaults to ~/.config/omacross/patterns.
